costo_totale.frammento: The total cost of fees and tests is £1,226

costo_valutazione.frammento: Qualification evaluation fee Paid to NMC on submission of eligibility and qualification application. This fee is non-refundable. £167

costo_cbt.frammento: Computer based test (CBT) cost Paid to test provider before test. £83 first sitting

costo_cbt_resit.frammento: For both Clinical and Numeracy £83 full resit

costo_osce.frammento: Objective structured clinical examination (OSCE) cost Paid to test provider before exam. £794 first sitting

costo_osce_resit.frammento: Payable if candidate fails in eight or more stations. £794 full resit

costo_osce_parziale.frammento: Payable if candidate fails in up to seven stations. £397 partial resit

costo_iscrizione.frammento: Registration fee Paid to NMC on submission of registration application. This fee is refundable in certain circumstances. £182

costo_aumento.frammento: Please note our fees increased on 1 October 2026.

costo_escluso.frammento: This doesn't include the cost of your visa, flights to the UK and any accommodation and travel while in the UK.

costo_resit.frammento: These costs could be higher if you need to resit tests.

codice_da_oms.frammento: The red list is drawn from the WHO Health Workforce Support and Safeguards List 2023

codice_no_attivo.frammento: No active recruitment of health and care staff will be undertaken from countries on the red list.

codice_rosso.frammento: Countries on the WHO health workforce support and safeguards list are graded red, which means no active recruitment is permitted from these countries.

codice_ambra.frammento: The country will be added to the amber list and recruitment can happen only on the terms of the agreement.

codice_verde.frammento: Active recruitment is permitted from green graded countries.

codice_diretta.frammento: Individual health and social care employers may consider direct applications from individuals who are resident in countries on the code red and amber list

codice_diretta_def.frammento: A direct application can only be made in response to a specific advertised vacancy that is hosted by, and recruited to, the same sponsoring organisation.

codice_3anni.frammento: The WHO health workforce support and safeguards list is updated by WHO every 3 years, or more frequently if required.

oms_flessibilita.frammento: The update of the SSL from 2026 onwards includes the flexibility option in its application

oms_finale.frammento: After incorporating Member State responses, WHO publishes the final list of countries and shares them with Member States and the public.

oms_3anni.frammento: The SSL is scheduled to be updated every 3 years or earlier if necessary
